title.zh-CN: 胸交感神经链切断术后第5天 · 51岁女性

summary.zh-CN: 胸交感神经链切断术后第5天的51岁女性，既往检查中发现过心脏问题；今天要拔除她的右颈内静脉导管。
summary.en: A 51-year-old woman, five days after a thoracic sympathectomy and with a heart problem found on earlier tests, is due to have her right internal jugular line removed today.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按INS 2024标准安全拔除颈内静脉导管——穿刺点低于心脏、呼气后屏气时拔出、按压至止血、用不透气的封闭敷料覆盖、拔后平卧一段时间（国内按WS/T 433—2023操作），并把心内分流伴肺动脉高压视为需要格外小心的理由。
learningOutcomes.en: Remove an internal jugular line safely as INS 2024 sets out — site below the heart, out during a breath-hold after breathing out, pressure to haemostasis, an air-occlusive dressing, a period lying flat (in China, under WS/T 433—2023) — and treat an intracardiac shunt with pulmonary hypertension as a reason for extra care.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 当拔管后数分钟内出现意识丧失和抽搐时，在床旁识别脑气体栓塞而不等待影像，并与惊厥性晕厥、缺血性卒中、肺栓塞和首次癫痫发作相鉴别（Moon，UHMS 2019）。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise cerebral gas embolism at the bedside when unresponsiveness and seizures follow line removal within minutes, without waiting for imaging, and tell it apart from convulsive syncope, ischaemic stroke, pulmonary embolism and a first epileptic seizure (Moon, UHMS 2019).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在最初几分钟开始急救：封闭穿刺点，让患者保持水平位而不是头低位，给予100%氧，保护气道，按AES 2016控制持续的抽搐，并查血糖。
learningOutcomes.en: Start first aid in the first minutes: seal the site, keep the patient horizontal rather than head-down, give 100 % oxygen, secure the airway, stop a continuing seizure as AES 2016 recommends, and check the glucose.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 尽快安排高压氧治疗并完成加压前检查——胸部手术后先排除气胸、气管导管套囊改注生理盐水——并能解释为什么CT阴性也不能取消治疗（UHMS 2023；ECHM 2016）。
learningOutcomes.en: Arrange urgent hyperbaric oxygen with its pre-compression checks — a pneumothorax excluded after chest surgery, saline in the tube cuff — and explain why a clear CT would not cancel it (UHMS 2023; ECHM 2016).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 说明为什么从现有记录无法确定气体进入脑部的途径，以及心内分流伴肺动脉高压对今后输液和心脏随访意味着什么（ESC 2020成人先心病指南）。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain why the route the air took cannot be established from the record, and what a shunt with pulmonary hypertension means for her future lines and cardiac follow-up (ESC 2020 adult congenital heart disease).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 向家属坦诚说明这一医源性并发症、表示歉意并上报不良事件（GMC/NMC职业坦诚义务 2015，2022年更新；《医疗纠纷预防和处理条例》2018）。
learningOutcomes.en: Disclose an iatrogenic complication to the family honestly, apologise and report it (GMC/NMC professional duty of candour 2015, updated 2022; China's Regulations on the Prevention and Handling of Medical Disputes 2018).

notes.zh-CN: 依据已发表的单例报告改写。本版本（1.1.0）的患者事实全部沿用1.0.0版从报告中提取的内容，按阶段重新组织，并改写为患者和家属的口语，没有增加或改动任何数值、时间、药物、体征或结局；尚未对照原文全文核对。患者为化名，医院、日历日期和身份细节已去除，时间以相对时间表示。拔管地点（本病例放在病房）、由谁拔管、转入ICU的时间、陪在ICU的家属及其对话，以及决策、干预、评分和教学要点均为教学设计；1.0.0版写作“左侧重瘫”，英文为“severe left hemiplegia”，本版写作“左侧重度偏瘫”，与英文一致，并列入待核实。经审核批准的原图（fig01）仅在复盘时随结局记录显示。
notes.en: Adapted from a published single-case report. In this version (1.1.0) every patient fact is the one extracted from the report for version 1.0.0, reorganised by phase and reworded into the patient's and the relative's lay speech; no value, timing, drug, sign or outcome has been added or changed, and the facts have not yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals, calendar dates and identifying details are removed, and times are relative. Where the line came out (placed on the ward here), who removed it, when she reached intensive care, the relative in intensive care and the dialogue, decisions, interventions, scoring and teaching points are educational design. Version 1.0.0 wrote 左侧重瘫 in Chinese and 'severe left hemiplegia' in English; this version writes 左侧重度偏瘫 to match the English and lists the point to verify. The approved figure (fig01) is shown only with the outcome record in the debrief.

triageNote.zh-CN: 51岁女性，胸交感神经链切断术后第5天，右颈内静脉中心静脉导管今天拔除。最初因双手遇冷发白、疼痛就诊，那次检查中发现过心脏问题。
triageNote.en: 51-year-old woman, post-operative day 5 after a thoracic sympathectomy; her right internal jugular central line is due out today. She first presented with hands that turn white and painful in the cold, and a heart problem was found during that work-up.

tags.en: Hands white and painful in the cold

personality.zh-CN: 51岁，胸部手术后第五天。说话平和，配合查房；对今天拔管有点紧张，问什么答什么。
personality.en: 51 and five days after a chest operation. Calm and cooperative on the ward round; a little nervous about the line coming out today, and answers what she is asked.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 日常口语，句子不长；不用医学术语，医生告诉过她的病名会照着说出来。
speechStyle.en: Everyday speech in short sentences; no medical jargon, though she repeats the names the doctors have told her.

openingLine.zh-CN: 医生，手术做完今天第五天了，说今天要把我右边脖子上这根管子拔掉。
openingLine.en: Doctor, it's five days since my operation, and they say the line in the right side of my neck is coming out today.

concerns.en: Will it hurt when the line comes out?

concerns.zh-CN: 拔了是不是就能早点出院？
concerns.en: Does it mean I can go home sooner?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 拔管前：清醒、配合，有点紧张，用自己的话回答，只说问到的内容，不增减数字和时间；问到不知道的，就说说不上来，不要编。拔管后她突然失去反应，从那时起不能说话；到ICU后由家属回答，家属只知道医生告诉他们的情况。
actingNotes.en: Before the line comes out: alert, cooperative and a little nervous; answer in her own words, only what is asked, never adding or changing numbers or times; for anything she does not know, say so — never invent. After the removal she suddenly stops responding and cannot speak from then on; in intensive care her relative answers, knowing only what the doctors have told the family.

persona.zh-CN: 她的家属，具体关系没有记录，在ICU陪着她。着急、害怕，说话直白，用日常的话；只知道医生告诉家里的情况，数值让医生去看病历，不知道的就说不知道，不替她编。最想知道她能不能醒过来，以及这件事是怎么发生的。
persona.en: A family member — the exact relationship is not recorded — who stays with her in intensive care. Worried and frightened, speaks plainly in everyday words; knows only what the doctors have told the family, points the doctor to the notes for figures, says so when they do not know and never makes anything up for her. Above all wants to know whether she will wake up, and how this happened.

description.en: Post-operative day 5 after a thoracic sympathectomy. She is alert, and her right internal jugular line is due out today.

name.zh-CN: 原报告的后续经过与结局

date.en: From the event to about day 35

text.zh-CN: 原报告记录：她接受了呼吸支持、高压氧治疗和康复治疗。次日神志转清，但左侧重度偏瘫；此后逐渐好转，约第35天能独立行走。报告讨论了不止一种可能的进气途径（经房间隔缺损的反常栓塞和经静脉逆行），没有直接观察到气体走的是哪一条。本病例没有记录高压氧开始的时间、压力、每次时长和次数，机械通气多久、何时拔除气管导管，用过的其他药物，也没有更长时间的随访（包括认知功能）。这一经过是历史记录，不是教学答案。
text.en: The report records respiratory support, hyperbaric oxygen and rehabilitation. She was alert the next day but with severe left hemiplegia; she then improved gradually and walked independently by about day 35. The report discusses more than one possible route for the air (paradoxical embolism across the atrial septal defect, and retrograde passage through the veins) without direct observation of which one it took. This case does not record when hyperbaric oxygen began, the pressure, the session length or the number of sessions, how long she was ventilated or when she was extubated, any other drugs, or any longer follow-up (cognition included). This course is the historical record, not the teaching answer.

name.en: Remove the right internal jugular line

dose.zh-CN: 按你定好的方法拔除：体位、呼吸配合、按压和敷料。
dose.en: Remove it as you have planned: position, breathing, pressure and dressing.

harm.zh-CN: 还没定好拔管方法就拔了：她有房间隔缺损和肺动脉高压，进入静脉的空气可能进入动脉。拔颈部导管前要先定好体位、屏气、按压、封闭敷料和拔后平卧的时间（INS 2024）。
harm.en: You took the line out before settling how: with an atrial septal defect and pulmonary hypertension, air entering her veins could reach her arteries. Plan the position, breath-hold, pressure, air-occlusive dressing and time lying flat before a neck line comes out (INS 2024).

response.zh-CN: 导管已拔出。原报告记录：她平卧拔管，穿刺点按压约1分钟，用普通胶布覆盖；约3分钟后她坐了起来。之后的经过按原报告进行。
response.en: The line is out. The report records that she lay flat for the removal, the site was pressed for about 1 minute and covered with ordinary adhesive tape, and about 3 minutes later she sat up. The case follows the report from here.

dose.zh-CN: 床头略放低，以她能耐受为限；只用于拔管的那几分钟。
dose.en: Lower the head of the bed slightly, as far as she tolerates — for the minutes of the removal only.

harm.zh-CN: 她失去反应以后不再推荐头低位：浮力对动脉内气泡的走向影响很小，头低位还可能加重脑水肿；让她保持水平位（Moon，UHMS 2019）。
harm.en: Head-down after the collapse is no longer recommended: buoyancy does little to steer bubbles in the arteries, and head-down can worsen cerebral oedema; keep her horizontal (Moon, UHMS 2019).

dose.zh-CN: 水平位，床头不抬高也不放低：气道未保护时侧卧（恢复体位），插管后仰卧。
dose.en: Horizontal, the head neither raised nor lowered: on her side (recovery position) while her airway is unprotected, on her back once it is secured.

response.zh-CN: 她已放平。本病例没有记录发病后她的体位是怎样调整的。
response.en: She is lying flat. This case does not record how she was positioned after the collapse.

en: raise the head of the bed

dose.en: Raise the head of the bed or help her sit up.

harm.zh-CN: 导管拔出后针道还没封好就让她坐起，穿刺点会高于心脏，颈静脉内压力可低于大气压，空气可经针道被吸入（INS 2024）；她失去反应以后应保持水平位（Moon，UHMS 2019）。
harm.en: Sitting her up with the tract unsealed puts the puncture above the heart, where pressure in the neck vein can fall below atmospheric and draw air in through the tract (INS 2024); after the collapse, keep her horizontal (Moon, UHMS 2019).

name.zh-CN: 呼救：启动院内急救团队
name.en: Call for help: the hospital emergency team

dose.zh-CN: 呼叫院内急救（快速反应）团队和上级医生到床旁。
dose.en: Call the hospital emergency (rapid response) team and a senior doctor to the bedside.

response.zh-CN: 急救团队正在赶来。本病例没有记录是否呼叫过急救团队；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The team is on its way. This case does not record whether the emergency team was called; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 按压并封闭颈部穿刺点
name.en: Press on and seal the neck puncture

dose.zh-CN: 立即用手指按压，再用凡士林纱布加透明敷料等不透气的封闭敷料覆盖。
dose.en: Press with a finger at once, then cover it with an air-occlusive dressing such as petroleum gauze under a transparent film.

response.zh-CN: 穿刺点已按压并封闭。原报告记录拔管后用的是普通胶布；本病例没有记录发病后穿刺点是否重新封闭；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The site is pressed and sealed. The report records ordinary adhesive tape after the removal; this case does not record whether the site was re-sealed after the collapse, and does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 储氧面罩高流量吸氧（15 L/min）
name.en: High-flow oxygen by non-rebreather mask (15 L/min)

dose.zh-CN: 储氧面罩，氧流量15 L/min，尽量接近纯氧；插管后FiO₂ 1.0。
dose.en: Non-rebreather mask at 15 L/min, as close to 100 % oxygen as possible; FiO₂ 1.0 once intubated.

response.zh-CN: 已高流量吸氧。原报告记录她发病后接受了吸氧；本病例没有记录给氧方式、流量和血氧饱和度。
response.en: High-flow oxygen is on. The report records that she was given oxygen; this case does not record the device, the flow or her oxygen saturation.

dose.zh-CN: 心电、无创血压和血氧饱和度持续监护。
dose.en: Continuous ECG, non-invasive blood pressure and oxygen saturation.

response.zh-CN: 监护已连接。本病例没有记录她的心率、血压、呼吸频率和血氧饱和度。
response.en: The monitor is on. This case does not record her heart rate, blood pressure, respiratory rate or oxygen saturation.

dose.zh-CN: 外周静脉留置针；连接任何输液之前先排净输液器和注射器里的空气。
dose.en: A peripheral cannula; de-air every giving set and syringe before connecting it.

response.zh-CN: 外周静脉通路已建立。本病例没有记录中心静脉导管拔除后她的静脉通路情况。
response.en: A peripheral cannula is in. This case does not record her venous access after the central line came out.

dose.zh-CN: 抽搐持续时：劳拉西泮0.1 mg/kg静脉注射（最大4 mg）或地西泮0.15–0.2 mg/kg静脉注射（最大10 mg），必要时重复1次；没有静脉通路时咪达唑仑肌内注射（体重>40 kg用10 mg）（AES 2016）。注意呼吸抑制。
dose.en: For a seizure that continues: lorazepam 0.1 mg/kg IV (max 4 mg) or diazepam 0.15–0.2 mg/kg IV (max 10 mg), repeated once if needed; without IV access, midazolam IM (10 mg if > 40 kg) (AES 2016). Watch for respiratory depression.

response.zh-CN: 已给药。本病例没有记录是否用过抗惊厥药物，也没有记录抽搐持续了多久；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Given. This case does not record whether any anticonvulsant was given or how long the seizure lasted; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 快速顺序诱导气管插管，纯氧机械通气
name.en: Rapid-sequence intubation and ventilation with 100 % oxygen

dose.zh-CN: 快速顺序诱导后气管插管，FiO₂ 1.0通气，维持正常二氧化碳分压；诱导前后避免低血压。
dose.en: Rapid-sequence induction and intubation, then ventilation on FiO₂ 1.0 aiming for a normal PaCO₂; avoid hypotension around induction.

response.zh-CN: 气管插管完成，开始机械通气。原报告记录她给氧后行气管插管；本病例没有记录插管的时间和用药。
response.en: She is intubated and ventilated. The report records intubation after oxygen; this case does not record when it was done or the drugs used.

dose.zh-CN: 需要时带转运呼吸机、监护和抢救药品，转运中保持水平位。
dose.en: With a transport ventilator, monitoring and emergency drugs as needed; keep her horizontal on the way.

response.zh-CN: ICU已接收，她被转入重症监护室。本病例没有记录转入的时间。
response.en: Intensive care accepts her and she is moved there. This case does not record when she was moved.

dose.zh-CN: 电话说明病情，商定加压的时机、治疗方案和加压前准备。
dose.en: Phone to describe her and agree the timing, the treatment table and the preparation for compression.

response.zh-CN: 高压氧科医生在准备舱位，会和你一起核对加压前清单。本病例没有记录何时联系了高压氧科；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The hyperbaric physician is preparing the chamber and will go through the pre-compression checklist with you. This case does not record when the hyperbaric team was contacted; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 高压氧治疗（送入高压氧舱）

dose.zh-CN: 按高压氧科医生开具的治疗方案加压（常用美国海军6号治疗表）；加压前排除气胸（有则先引流），气管导管套囊改注生理盐水，使用舱内可用的呼吸机和输液泵。
dose.en: Compress on the treatment table the hyperbaric physician prescribes (commonly US Navy Treatment Table 6); before compression exclude a pneumothorax (drain one first), fill the tube cuff with saline, and use a chamber-compatible ventilator and pumps.

harm.zh-CN: 加压前没有排除气胸：她5天前做过胸部手术，没有引流的气胸在减压时可变成张力性气胸。先拍胸片（或做肺部超声），有气胸先放引流（UHMS 2023；ECHM 2016）。
harm.en: No check for a pneumothorax before compression: she had chest surgery 5 days ago, and an undrained pneumothorax can become a tension pneumothorax on decompression. Get a chest film (or lung ultrasound) first and drain any pneumothorax (UHMS 2023; ECHM 2016).

response.zh-CN: 她被送入高压氧舱开始治疗。原报告记录她接受了高压氧治疗；本病例没有记录加压前的胸片或有无气胸（实际工作中要等这项检查有了结果再加压），也没有记录开始的时间、压力、每次时长和次数，不模拟其效果。
response.en: She is taken into the chamber and treatment begins. The report records hyperbaric oxygen; this case records neither the pre-compression chest film nor whether there was a pneumothorax (in practice compression waits for that check), nor when treatment started, the pressure, the session length or the number of sessions, and it does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 0.9 mg/kg（最大90 mg），10%静脉推注，其余60分钟内输完。
dose.en: 0.9 mg/kg (max 90 mg): 10 % as an IV bolus, the rest over 60 minutes.

harm.zh-CN: 溶栓药溶解的是血栓，对气体无效；她5天前刚做过手术，近期大手术是溶栓需要逐例权衡的禁忌情形（AHA/ASA 2026急性缺血性卒中指南）。溶栓可能引起手术部位和颅内出血，还会推迟纯氧和高压氧。
harm.en: Thrombolytics dissolve clot, not gas; she had surgery 5 days ago, and recent major surgery is a contraindication that needs individual weighing (AHA/ASA 2026 acute ischaemic stroke guideline). Lysis risks bleeding at the operation site and in the brain, and it delays oxygen and recompression.

name.zh-CN: 普通肝素（治疗剂量）静脉推注并持续泵入
name.en: Therapeutic-dose unfractionated heparin (IV bolus and infusion)

dose.zh-CN: 按体重给负荷量后持续泵入，按APTT调整。
dose.en: A weight-based bolus, then an infusion adjusted to the APTT.

harm.zh-CN: 治疗剂量的肝素既不能处理气体栓塞，也不能终止抽搐；她5天前做过胸部手术、颈部刚拔过管，抗凝会增加出血风险，还会拖延纯氧和高压氧。
harm.en: Therapeutic heparin treats neither gas embolism nor a seizure; five days after chest surgery and with a fresh neck puncture it adds bleeding risk, and it delays oxygen and recompression.

dose.zh-CN: 与上级医生和责任护士一起，在安静的地方：说明发生了什么、正在做的治疗和不确定的预后，表示歉意，回答问题并记录谈话。
dose.en: With the senior doctor and her nurse, somewhere quiet: explain what happened, the treatment and the uncertain outlook, apologise, answer questions and record the conversation.

response.zh-CN: 家属在听你说明。本病例没有记录医生与家属谈了什么。
response.en: The relative is listening. This case does not record what the family was told.

dose.zh-CN: 按医院的不良事件报告制度上报，并提出拔管流程的改进：封闭敷料、拔后平卧时间、标记有心内分流的患者。
dose.en: Report it through the hospital's adverse-event system and propose changes to the removal procedure: air-occlusive dressing, time lying flat, flagging patients with an intracardiac shunt.

response.zh-CN: 事件已上报。本病例没有记录是否上报过不良事件。
response.en: The incident is reported. This case does not record whether an incident report was made.

name.zh-CN: 请康复科会诊，尽早开始康复

dose.zh-CN: 病情稳定后尽早开始神经康复评估和训练。
dose.en: Neurological rehabilitation assessment and therapy as soon as she is stable.

response.zh-CN: 康复科会来评估。原报告记录她接受了康复治疗；本病例不模拟其效果。
response.en: Rehabilitation will assess her. The report records that she had rehabilitation; this case does not simulate its effect.

title.zh-CN: 拔管前：了解她，定好拔管方法
title.en: Before the line comes out: know her and plan the removal

hint.zh-CN: 她做的是什么手术、今天是术后第几天？心脏和肺查出过什么？导管在哪一侧？怎样拔，才能让针道在拔出时和拔出后都进不了气？
hint.en: What operation did she have, and which post-operative day is it? What was found in her heart and lungs? Which side is the line on? How do you take it out so that nothing can be drawn into the tract, during the removal and after it?

guidance.zh-CN: 术后第5天，她清醒，能自己回答问题；此前的超声心动图、手术记录和导管记录都在病历里。
guidance.en: Post-operative day 5: she is alert and answers for herself; the earlier echocardiogram, the operation note and the line record are in the notes.

title.zh-CN: 拔管之后：床旁评估与稳定
title.en: After the removal: assess and stabilise her

hint.zh-CN: 她能不能叫醒？呼吸、大动脉搏动和瞳孔怎么样？颈部的针眼现在是什么样子？哪一项床旁化验不能漏？
hint.en: Can she be roused? What are her breathing, central pulse and pupils doing? What does the neck puncture look like now, and which bedside test must not be missed?

guidance.zh-CN: 拔管后约3分钟，她坐起时出事；你就在她床旁，抢救车、氧气接口和监护仪都在。
guidance.en: About 3 minutes after the removal, as she sat up, she collapsed; you are at her bed, with the crash cart, the oxygen outlet and the monitor.

hint.zh-CN: 颈部针眼封好了吗？她现在的体位、吸入的氧浓度合适吗？谁需要马上到床旁？
hint.en: Is the neck puncture sealed? Are her position and the oxygen she is breathing right? Who needs to be at the bedside now?

guidance.en: At the same time, at her bed.

title.en: Intensive care: the next few hours

hint.zh-CN: 最根本的治疗是什么，能不能等影像？她5天前做过胸部手术，开始之前必须先排除什么？
hint.en: What is the definitive treatment, and should it wait for imaging? She had chest surgery 5 days ago — what must be excluded before it starts?

guidance.zh-CN: 她已插管，在ICU接受呼吸支持。
guidance.en: She is intubated and on respiratory support in intensive care.

title.zh-CN: 病因的来路，以及与家属沟通
title.en: Where it came from, and the family

hint.zh-CN: 把CT、超声心动图和她的瞳孔检查放在一起，能证明什么，不能证明什么？家属现在知道多少，最怕什么？
hint.en: Put the CT, the echo and her pupil finding together: what can they prove, and what can they not? What does the family know so far, and what do they fear?

guidance.zh-CN: 她在ICU，一位家属陪在床旁。
guidance.en: She is in intensive care, with a relative at the bedside.

title.zh-CN: 回看原报告的经过与结局
title.en: Review the reported course and outcome

hint.zh-CN: 原报告记录了哪些治疗和结局，哪些没有记录？和你的处理比一比，哪些做法今天会不同？
hint.en: Which treatments and outcomes does the report record, and which does it not? Set them beside what you did: what would be done differently today?

guidance.zh-CN: 复盘阶段：结局记录在病历中。
guidance.en: Debrief stage: the outcome record is in the notes.

prompt.zh-CN: 华女士51岁，胸交感神经链切断术后第5天；此前的超声心动图示房间隔缺损和肺动脉高压。右颈内静脉导管今天要拔除。你怎样拔？
prompt.en: Ms Hua is 51, on day 5 after a thoracic sympathectomy; her earlier echocardiogram showed an atrial septal defect and pulmonary hypertension. Her right internal jugular line comes out today. How do you remove it?

need.zh-CN: 先问清手术和颈部导管，并在病历中看过此前的超声心动图和导管记录。
need.en: Ask about the operation and the neck line, and read the earlier echocardiogram and the line record first.

text.zh-CN: 平卧，能耐受就略放低床头，使穿刺点低于心脏；呼气后屏气时拔出；按压至止血，不透气敷料封闭至少24小时；拔后平卧约30分钟
text.en: Flat, head down if tolerated, site below the heart; out during a breath-hold after breathing out; pressure until bleeding stops; an air-occlusive dressing for 24 hours or more; flat for about 30 minutes

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。拔颈部中心静脉导管时，穿刺点要低于心脏，在呼气后屏气（或Valsalva动作）时拔出，按压至止血，用不透气的封闭敷料覆盖，并保持平卧一段时间，以免空气经针道被吸入（INS 2024输液治疗实践标准）。她有房间隔缺损和肺动脉高压，进入静脉的空气可能进入动脉，每一步都更重要。
feedback.en: Right. For a neck line the site goes below the heart, the catheter comes out during a breath-hold after breathing out (or a Valsalva manoeuvre), pressure continues to haemostasis, an air-occlusive dressing covers the tract and she stays lying down for a while, so that no air is drawn in (INS Infusion Therapy Standards of Practice 2024). With an atrial septal defect and pulmonary hypertension, venous air could reach her arteries, so every step matters more.

text.zh-CN: 平卧拔出，按压约1分钟，再用普通胶布贴好；看针眼不再出血了，就告诉她什么时候想坐起来、下床活动都可以
text.en: Flat for the pull and about a minute of pressure, then ordinary adhesive tape over the site; once it has stopped bleeding she can sit up, get out of bed and walk about whenever she feels like it

feedback.zh-CN: 平卧拔管是对的，但只按压1分钟、用普通胶布贴，针道并没有封住；拔后很快坐起，穿刺点会高于心脏，颈静脉内压力可低于大气压，空气就可能经针道被吸入。应该用不透气的封闭敷料封住针道（INS 2024），拔管后再平卧一段时间。
feedback.en: Lying flat for the pull is right, but a minute of pressure and ordinary tape leave the tract unsealed, and sitting up soon afterwards puts the site above the heart, where pressure in the neck vein can fall below atmospheric and draw air in through the tract. Seal the tract with an air-occlusive dressing (INS 2024) and keep her lying down for a while after removal.

text.zh-CN: 让她半坐位（约45°）舒服一些，拔管时嘱她深吸一口气；按压到不出血，贴透明薄膜敷料，之后照常下床活动
text.en: Sit her up at about 45° for comfort and pull the line as she takes a deep breath in; pressure until it stops bleeding, a clear film dressing, then up and about as usual

feedback.zh-CN: 半坐位让穿刺点高于心脏，深吸气又在针道打开的那一刻使胸内静脉压低于大气压——这是拔管时空气进入最典型的条件（INS 2024）。宾夕法尼亚患者安全管理局2012年的分析中，拔管时患者处于直立位是最常报告的相关因素。
feedback.en: Sitting up puts the puncture above the heart, and a deep breath in makes the pressure in the chest veins sub-atmospheric just as the tract opens — the classic conditions for air entry at removal (INS 2024). In the Pennsylvania Patient Safety Authority's 2012 analysis, an upright position at removal was the most often reported contributing factor.

text.zh-CN: 床头放低、让她屏住气时拔出，按压到不再出血；之后盖一块干纱布就行，针道几分钟内就会闭合，所以她可以马上坐起来、下床走动，不用再躺着
text.en: Head down and breath held for the pull, then pressure until the bleeding stops; after that a dry gauze pad is enough, because the tract closes within minutes, so she can sit up and walk about straight away instead of lying there

feedback.zh-CN: 体位和屏气都对，但颈部导管的皮下针道在止血以后仍可能开放，空气可以穿过干纱布被吸入，拔管后数小时仍有发生空气栓塞的报道。应该用不透气的封闭敷料覆盖（INS 2024），通常保留至少24小时，并在坐起前平卧一段时间。
feedback.en: The position and breath-hold are right, but the subcutaneous tract of a neck line can stay open after the bleeding stops, air can be drawn through dry gauze, and air embolism has been reported hours after removal. Seal it with an air-occlusive dressing (INS 2024), commonly left for at least 24 hours, and keep her lying down for a while before she sits up.

text.zh-CN: 她有房间隔缺损和肺动脉高压，拔管风险太大：导管先留着，等心脏缺损修补以后再拔
text.en: With an atrial septal defect and pulmonary hypertension the removal is too risky: leave the line in until the defect has been repaired, then take it out

feedback.zh-CN: 不需要的中心静脉导管不应保留：每多留一天都增加感染和血栓的风险；而肺动脉高压时房间隔缺损能否修补是另一项需要专科评估的决定，可能根本不能做。拔管的风险要靠方法来控制——体位、屏气和封闭敷料（INS 2024），再加上拔后平卧。
feedback.en: An unneeded central line should not stay in: each extra day adds infection and thrombosis risk, and whether an ASD can be closed in pulmonary hypertension is a separate specialist decision that may go against closure altogether. The risk of removal is controlled by technique — position, breath-hold and an air-occlusive seal (INS 2024), then time lying flat.

prompt.zh-CN: 导管拔出后约3分钟，她坐起来时突然呼之不应、呼吸短促并抽搐。你判断发生了什么？现在马上做什么？
prompt.en: About 3 minutes after the line came out, as she sat up, she suddenly stopped responding, with short, rapid breaths and convulsions. What is happening, and what do you do right now?

need.zh-CN: 先到床旁对她做一项检查。
need.en: Examine her at the bedside first (any one examination).

text.zh-CN: 先按经颈部针道进入的空气栓塞处理：封闭穿刺点，放平，高流量纯氧，呼救，保护气道并止抽，查血糖，通知ICU和高压氧科，不等CT
text.en: Air through the neck puncture until proven otherwise: seal the site, lay her flat, 100 % oxygen, call for help, protect the airway, stop the fit, check glucose, alert ICU and the hyperbaric team, no scan first

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。拔管后数分钟、坐起时突然呼之不应并抽搐，首先要想到气体栓塞，诊断靠临床；血管内气体在影像上常常看不到，影像不能用来排除诊断（Moon，UHMS 2019），所以先急救、不等CT。纯氧可以缩小气泡并改善缺氧；保持水平位——头低位已不再推荐（Moon 2019）；高压氧要尽早安排。
feedback.en: Right. Sudden unresponsiveness and convulsions within minutes of line removal, on sitting up, are gas embolism first, and the diagnosis is clinical; intravascular gas is often invisible on imaging, which must not be used to exclude it (Moon, UHMS 2019) — so treat first, without waiting for a scan. 100 % oxygen shrinks bubbles and treats hypoxia; keep her horizontal, as head-down is no longer recommended (Moon 2019); and set up hyperbaric oxygen early.

text.zh-CN: 术后第一次坐起时发生的晕厥伴短暂抽动：让她平躺、抬高双腿，查血糖，留在病房继续观察；如果10分钟以后还没醒过来，再呼叫急救团队
text.en: A faint with brief jerks on first sitting up after surgery: lie her down with her legs raised, check her glucose and keep watching her on the ward, calling the team only if she has not come round in 10 minutes

feedback.zh-CN: 第一次坐起时的惊厥性晕厥确实存在，但平躺后几秒钟内抽动就会停止、意识很快恢复；颈部导管拔出后数分钟出现的呼之不应伴抽搐，不能先当晕厥观察。等10分钟会错过纯氧和尽早加压最有价值的时间（Moon，UHMS 2019）。
feedback.en: Convulsive syncope on first sitting up does happen, but the jerks stop within seconds of lying flat and consciousness returns quickly; unresponsiveness with convulsions minutes after a neck line came out cannot be watched as a faint. Waiting 10 minutes loses the time in which oxygen and early recompression matter most (Moon, UHMS 2019).

text.zh-CN: 血栓经房间隔缺损引起的急性缺血性卒中：马上送去做头颅CT和CT血管成像，排除出血后静脉阿替普酶溶栓，同时请卒中团队会诊
text.en: An acute ischaemic stroke from a clot crossing the septal defect: straight to head CT and CT angiography, then IV alteplase once bleeding has been excluded, with the stroke team called to see her

feedback.zh-CN: 这是按血栓处理，但发病时间——导管拔出后数分钟、她坐起的那一刻——指向空气而不是血栓；溶栓药溶解不了气体，她5天前刚做过手术，近期大手术本身就是溶栓需要逐例权衡的禁忌情形（AHA/ASA 2026）。先去做CT会推迟纯氧和加压，而且CT阴性也不能排除气体栓塞（Moon 2019）。
feedback.en: This treats a clot, but the timing — minutes after the line came out, as she sat up — points to air, not thrombus; thrombolysis cannot dissolve gas, and recent major surgery 5 days ago is itself a contraindication needing individual weighing (AHA/ASA 2026). Going to CT first delays oxygen and recompression, and a clear scan would not exclude gas embolism (Moon 2019).

text.zh-CN: 术后第5天的大面积肺栓塞：立即静脉推注普通肝素，安排CT肺动脉造影；如果血压下降，就进行溶栓
text.en: A massive pulmonary embolism on day 5 after surgery: an unfractionated heparin bolus now and a CT pulmonary angiogram, with thrombolysis if her blood pressure falls

feedback.zh-CN: 严重到让人倒下的肺栓塞通常表现为休克和低氧，而不是在颈部导管拔出后数分钟、坐起时突然呼之不应和抽搐。肝素处理不了气体，又在胸部手术后5天增加出血风险；溶栓只用于高危肺栓塞（ESC 2019急性肺栓塞指南），这里同样有出血风险。
feedback.en: A pulmonary embolism severe enough to fell her usually shows itself as shock and hypoxaemia, not as sudden unresponsiveness and convulsions minutes after a neck line came out, as she sat up. Heparin does nothing for gas and adds bleeding risk 5 days after chest surgery, and thrombolysis is for high-risk PE (ESC 2019 acute PE guideline), with the same bleeding hazard.

text.zh-CN: 首次癫痫发作：静脉注射地西泮，摆成恢复体位，今晚在病房观察，明天安排脑电图检查和神经内科会诊
text.en: A first epileptic seizure: IV diazepam, the recovery position, observation on the ward tonight, and an EEG with a neurology review tomorrow

feedback.zh-CN: 这里的抽搐是症状，不是诊断：颈部导管拔出后数分钟首次出现抽搐、呼之不应，必须马上处理病因。抽搐不停时用苯二氮䓬类是对的（AES 2016），但在病房观察、明天再做脑电图，会漏掉空气栓塞，也错过纯氧和加压的时机。
feedback.en: The seizure is a symptom here, not the diagnosis: a first fit with unresponsiveness minutes after a neck line came out needs its cause treated at once. A benzodiazepine for a seizure that does not stop is right (AES 2016), but ward observation and an EEG tomorrow miss the air embolism and the window for oxygen and recompression.

prompt.zh-CN: 她已气管插管，在ICU接受呼吸支持。接下来的几个小时，你的计划是什么？
prompt.en: She is intubated and on respiratory support in intensive care. What is your plan for the next few hours?

need.zh-CN: 先在床旁查看她的气道和呼吸支持。
need.en: Check her airway and breathing support at the bedside first.

text.zh-CN: 尽快高压氧，不等再做影像：先拍床旁胸片排除气胸（有则先引流），气管导管套囊改注生理盐水，用舱内可用的呼吸机；其间维持纯氧、正常血压和血糖
text.en: Urgent hyperbaric oxygen without waiting for more imaging: a portable chest film first (drain any pneumothorax), saline in the tube cuff, a chamber-safe ventilator; meanwhile 100 % oxygen, normal blood pressure and glucose

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。高压氧是动脉气体栓塞的根本治疗，经血管通路进入的气体也包括在内：UHMS适应证手册（第15版，2023）将其列为适应证，ECHM 2016共识列为1类推荐；距发病越早加压，预后越好（Moon 2019）。加压前要排除气胸——她5天前做过胸部手术——并做好气道和呼吸机的准备。
feedback.en: Right. Hyperbaric oxygen is the definitive treatment of arterial gas embolism, including gas that enters through a vascular line: an indication in the UHMS Indications Manual (15th ed., 2023) and a Type 1 recommendation of the ECHM 2016 consensus, and a shorter delay to recompression goes with better outcomes (Moon 2019). Before compression exclude a pneumothorax — she had chest surgery 5 days ago — and prepare the airway and ventilator.

text.zh-CN: 先看头颅CT再决定：CT上看到气体才做高压氧；要是CT上已经看不到气体，说明空气已经吸收，留在ICU里做支持治疗、维持纯氧和正常血压就足够了
text.en: Let the head CT decide: hyperbaric oxygen only if the scan still shows gas; if it shows none, the air has already been absorbed, and supportive care in intensive care with 100 % oxygen and a normal blood pressure is enough

feedback.zh-CN: CT阴性不能取消治疗：血管内气体在影像上常常看不到，影像不能用来排除气体栓塞（Moon，UHMS 2019）。气泡从片子上消失，并不说明它造成的缺血损伤已经结束，而加压正是为了限制这种损伤。
feedback.en: A clear CT does not cancel treatment: intravascular gas is often invisible on imaging, which must not be used to exclude gas embolism (Moon, UHMS 2019). Bubbles gone from the scan do not mean the ischaemic injury they started is over — limiting that injury is what recompression is for.

text.zh-CN: 先用地塞米松和甘露醇控制脑水肿，等她病情稳定下来、能够脱离呼吸机以后，再考虑去做高压氧治疗
text.en: Dexamethasone and mannitol for brain swelling first, with hyperbaric oxygen considered once she is stable and off the ventilator

feedback.zh-CN: 糖皮质激素在气体栓塞中没有被证实的作用，不能代替加压；“等稳定了再说”会白白耗掉加压最有效的时间（Moon，UHMS 2019）。插管、机械通气的患者可以在舱内治疗，ICU的高压氧舱就是为此准备的。
feedback.en: Corticosteroids have no proven role in gas embolism and cannot stand in for recompression, and 'once she is stable' throws away the time in which recompression works best (Moon, UHMS 2019). Intubated, ventilated patients can be treated in the chamber — the ICU chamber is there for exactly this.

text.zh-CN: 高压氧只用于潜水员的减压病；对于经输液管路进入的空气，头低位保持24小时、用纯氧机械通气就够了
text.en: Hyperbaric oxygen is for divers' decompression illness; for air that came in through a line, 24 hours head-down with ventilation on 100 % oxygen is enough

feedback.zh-CN: 任何原因引起的空气或气体栓塞——包括医源性的——都是公认的高压氧适应证（UHMS 2023；ECHM 2016）。头低位已不再推荐：浮力对动脉内气泡的走向影响很小，头低位还可能加重脑水肿（Moon 2019）。
feedback.en: Air or gas embolism of any cause — iatrogenic included — is an accepted hyperbaric indication (UHMS 2023; ECHM 2016). A head-down position is no longer recommended: buoyancy does little to steer bubbles in the arteries, and head-down can worsen cerebral oedema (Moon 2019).

text.zh-CN: 先过度通气把PaCO₂降得很低，再给高渗盐水控制颅内压；如果24小时后她仍然没有醒过来，再考虑做高压氧治疗
text.en: Hyperventilate to a low PaCO₂ and give hypertonic saline to bring the intracranial pressure down, then consider hyperbaric oxygen only if she has still not woken up after 24 hours

feedback.zh-CN: 在脑气体栓塞的动物研究中，人为降低二氧化碳分压没有显示获益（Moon，UHMS 2019）；PaCO₂过低会减少本已不足的脑血流，应维持正常通气。把加压推迟24小时，就放弃了它最有效的时机。
feedback.en: Induced hypocapnia has shown no benefit in animal studies of cerebral gas embolism (Moon, UHMS 2019), and a low PaCO₂ cuts blood flow to a brain already short of it — aim for normocapnia. Putting recompression off for 24 hours gives up its best window.

prompt.zh-CN: 急诊头颅CT示颅内空气栓塞；此前的超声心动图示房间隔缺损和肺动脉高压。导管在右颈内静脉，出事时她右侧瞳孔对光反射迟钝。空气最可能是怎样到达脑部的？这对她以后的治疗意味着什么？
prompt.en: The emergency head CT shows intracranial air embolism; the earlier echo showed an atrial septal defect with pulmonary hypertension. The line was in the right internal jugular vein, and at the collapse her right pupil reacted sluggishly. How did the air most likely reach her brain, and what follows for her care?

need.zh-CN: 先在ICU看急诊头颅CT报告，并确认已看过此前的超声心动图和她的瞳孔检查；先完成决策 3。
need.en: Read the emergency head CT report in intensive care, with the earlier echo and her pupil examination; answer decision 3 first.

text.zh-CN: 两条路都说得通、都没被看到：经房间隔缺损右向左分流，或坐起时沿右颈内静脉逆行上脑；处理相同。今后管路排净空气、加滤器，请心内科评估缺损和肺动脉压
text.en: Either route fits and neither was seen: right-to-left across the septal defect, or up the right jugular vein as she sat up; treatment is the same. De-air every future line, use filters, and have cardiology assess the defect and pressures

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。静脉内的空气可以经心内分流进入动脉——肺动脉高压时房间隔缺损可出现右向左分流——也可以在直立时沿颈内静脉逆行进入脑静脉（逆行性脑静脉气体栓塞；Bothma与Schlimp，2014），大量气体还可穿过肺毛细血管。现有记录不能区分是哪一条。无论哪条路，今后都要严格排净管路空气，并由专科评估缺损和肺动脉高压（ESC 2020成人先心病指南；ESC/ERS 2022肺动脉高压指南）。
feedback.en: Right. Venous air can reach the cerebral arteries across an intracardiac shunt — with pulmonary hypertension, right-to-left flow through an ASD is plausible — or rise up the jugular vein into the cerebral veins when the patient is upright (retrograde cerebral venous gas embolism; Bothma and Schlimp, 2014), and large volumes can cross the lung capillaries. Nothing recorded separates them. Either way her lines need meticulous de-airing, and the defect and the pulmonary hypertension need specialist assessment (ESC 2020 adult congenital heart disease; ESC/ERS 2022 pulmonary hypertension).

text.zh-CN: 超声心动图已经证明空气是经房间隔缺损过去的反常栓塞；趁这次住院、出院之前就安排经皮封堵，把缺损堵上，以后就不会再发生这种情况，也不必再做别的检查
text.en: The echo proves the air crossed the septal defect as a paradoxical embolism; arrange percutaneous closure of the defect before she leaves hospital, so that this cannot happen again and no further tests of the route or the pressures are needed

feedback.zh-CN: 超声心动图只说明缺损存在，并不能说明空气经过了它；没有任何检查显示了气泡的路径。肺动脉高压时能否封堵房间隔缺损，取决于右心导管测得的分流量和肺血管阻力——阻力经靶向治疗仍高时不推荐封堵（ESC 2020成人先心病指南）——这是成人先心病团队择期做的决定，不是紧急处理。
feedback.en: An echo shows that a defect exists, not that air crossed it; no study showed the bubbles' path. Whether an ASD can be closed in pulmonary hypertension depends on the shunt and the pulmonary vascular resistance measured at right-heart catheterisation — closure is not recommended when resistance stays high despite targeted therapy (ESC 2020 adult congenital heart disease) — a planned decision for an adult congenital heart team, not an emergency step.

text.zh-CN: 右侧瞳孔反射迟钝证明空气是沿着右颈内静脉逆行上到脑部的，房间隔缺损和这件事没有关系，今后输液和随访都不必再考虑它
text.en: The sluggish right pupil proves the air rose up the right jugular vein into her brain; the septal defect had nothing to do with it and needs no further thought for her lines or her follow-up

feedback.zh-CN: 右侧瞳孔反射迟钝是一个局灶体征，但说明不了气体是怎么到达的：经分流进入动脉的气体和沿静脉逆行的气体都可能造成这种表现；一个体征不能区分两条路径。缺损伴肺动脉高压对她今后的任何输液、置管和操作都仍然重要。
feedback.en: A sluggish right pupil is a focal sign, but it says nothing about how the gas got there: gas reaching the brain through the arteries after crossing the shunt could produce it as well as gas rising in the veins; one sign cannot tell the routes apart. The defect with pulmonary hypertension still matters for every future line, infusion and procedure.

text.zh-CN: 既然不管走哪条路处理都一样，这个问题就可以放下：以后输液不需要特别的防范，也不需要心内科随访
text.en: Since the treatment is the same whatever the route, the question can be dropped: no special precautions with future lines and no cardiology follow-up are needed

feedback.zh-CN: 急性期的处理确实相同，但途径问题有后果：有心内分流的患者今后每一条管路都要排净空气（能用滤器时用滤器）；肺动脉高压的病因和严重程度也需要评估（ESC/ERS 2022肺动脉高压指南）。
feedback.en: The acute treatment is indeed the same, but the route question has consequences: with an intracardiac shunt every future line must be de-aired (with filters where available), and the cause and severity of her pulmonary hypertension need assessment (ESC/ERS 2022 pulmonary hypertension guideline).

prompt.zh-CN: 她的家属问你：“是不是拔脖子上那根管子拔出的事？”你怎么回应？
prompt.en: Her relative asks you: 'Did taking the line out of her neck cause this?' How do you respond?

need.zh-CN: 先听听家属最担心什么，并完成决策 3。
need.en: Hear what worries the relative most, and answer decision 3 first.

text.zh-CN: 尽快和上级医生在安静处与家属谈：如实说明空气很可能是拔管时经颈部针眼进入的，道歉，解释高压氧和不确定的预后，记录谈话并上报不良事件
text.en: Meet the family soon, with the senior doctor, somewhere quiet: say plainly that air most likely entered through the neck puncture at the removal, apologise, explain hyperbaric oxygen and the uncertain outlook, record it and report the incident

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。出了问题，医务人员应当告诉患者或家属并道歉（GMC与NMC职业坦诚义务，2015年发布、2022年更新）；《医疗纠纷预防和处理条例》（国务院令第701号，2018）要求向患者说明病情和医疗措施，对特殊治疗说明风险和替代方案，并通过医患沟通机制回应疑问。尽早、如实地说明并讲清计划和不确定性，才能保住信任；上报不良事件是改进的起点。
feedback.en: Right. When something has gone wrong, clinicians must tell the patient or family and apologise (GMC and NMC professional duty of candour, 2015, updated 2022); China's Regulations on the Prevention and Handling of Medical Disputes (State Council Decree No. 701, 2018) require clinicians to explain the condition and the measures taken, explain the risks and alternatives of special treatments, and answer questions through a communication mechanism. Early, honest disclosure with the plan and the uncertainty keeps trust; the incident report starts the learning.

text.zh-CN: 告诉家属她是“中风”了，做完手术谁都有可能碰上这种事；在所有检查都做完、原因完全查清以前，先不要提拔管的事，免得引起不必要的误会和医疗纠纷
text.en: Tell the family she has had a stroke, which can happen to anyone after an operation, and leave the line removal out of it until every test is done and the cause is fully established, so as not to cause a misunderstanding or an unnecessary dispute

feedback.zh-CN: 说成“中风”掩盖了最可能的原因和它与拔管的关系；家属往往终会知道，隐瞒会毁掉信任，也违反职业坦诚义务（GMC与NMC 2015，2022年更新）。《医疗纠纷预防和处理条例》（2018）要求如实说明病情和医疗措施。
feedback.en: Calling it a stroke hides the most likely cause and its link to the removal; families usually find out, concealment destroys trust, and it breaches the duty of candour (GMC and NMC 2015, updated 2022). China's 2018 Regulations require the condition and the measures taken to be explained truthfully.

text.zh-CN: 告诉家属现在说什么都还太早，具体原因要等调查；等她醒过来、结果清楚以后再向家属解释，免得让他们现在更加难受
text.en: Tell the family it is too early to say anything while the cause is investigated, and explain only once she has woken and the outcome is clear, so as not to upset them further now

feedback.zh-CN: 等结局出来再说，会让家属在最需要解释的时候得不到解释；职业坦诚义务要求及时、如实地告知，即使还不是所有事实都清楚，也要把不确定性说明白（GMC与NMC 2015，2022年更新）。高压氧等特殊治疗也需要现在就向家属说明风险（《医疗纠纷预防和处理条例》2018）。
feedback.en: Waiting for the outcome leaves the family without the explanation they need now; the duty of candour asks for timely, honest disclosure even before every fact is known, with the uncertainty stated (GMC and NMC 2015, updated 2022). Special treatments such as hyperbaric oxygen also need their risks explained to the family now (Chinese Regulations, 2018).

text.zh-CN: 向家属说明，这类并发症是病人拔管以后坐起来太早引起的，医生护士都按常规做了，没有过错，所以不需要道歉，也不用上报
text.en: Explain that complications like this come from patients sitting up too soon after a line comes out; the staff followed routine and are not at fault, so no apology or incident report is needed

feedback.zh-CN: 把责任推给患者既不公平也不准确：拔管后防止进气——封闭敷料和平卧的时间——是团队的责任，不是她的。这违反了坦诚和道歉的职业义务（GMC与NMC 2015，2022年更新），也正是会把并发症变成纠纷的回答（《医疗纠纷预防和处理条例》2018）。
feedback.en: Blaming the patient is unjust and inaccurate: preventing air entry after removal — the seal and the time lying flat — is the team's job, not hers. It breaches the professional duty to be open and to apologise (GMC and NMC 2015, updated 2022), and it is exactly the answer that turns a complication into a dispute (Chinese Regulations, 2018).

text.zh-CN: 拔管前问清手术与术后天数、双手遇冷发白的病史、心脏和肺的问题、颈部导管，以及用药和抗凝、抽搐或糖尿病、术后胸部情况
text.en: Before the removal, asked about the operation and the day, the cold white hands, the heart and lung problem, the neck line, and her medicines and blood thinners, fits or diabetes, and her chest since surgery

text.zh-CN: 拔管前在病历中看过此前的超声心动图、手术记录和导管记录
text.en: Read the earlier echocardiogram, the operation note and the line record before the removal

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择能防止空气进入的拔管方法（决策 1）
text.en: Chose a removal technique that keeps air out, at the first attempt (decision 1)

text.zh-CN: 她失去反应时，在床旁评估意识、呼吸、抽搐、大动脉搏动、瞳孔和颈部穿刺处，并查了指尖血糖
text.en: When she collapsed, assessed her responsiveness, breathing, convulsions, central pulse, pupils and the neck puncture at the bedside, and checked a capillary glucose

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即在床旁判断病因并开始相应急救，不等影像（决策 2）
text.en: Identified the cause at the bedside and started the matching first aid without waiting for imaging, at the first attempt (decision 2)

text.zh-CN: 她刚失去反应、还在原床位时，就封闭了穿刺点，让她放平，给予高流量纯氧并呼救
text.en: While she was still where she collapsed, sealed the puncture, laid her flat, gave high-flow 100 % oxygen and called for help

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择尽快高压氧并做好加压前检查，并在ICU开出床旁胸片（决策 3）
text.en: Chose urgent hyperbaric oxygen with the pre-compression checks at the first attempt, and ordered the portable chest film in intensive care (decision 3)

text.zh-CN: 在看到结局记录之前给予了高压氧治疗
text.en: Gave hyperbaric oxygen before the outcome record was open

text.zh-CN: 没有给静脉溶栓，也没有给治疗剂量的肝素
text.en: Gave no thrombolysis and no therapeutic-dose heparin

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即说明进气途径无法从记录中确定，以及这对她今后治疗的意义（决策 4）
text.en: Explained at the first attempt why the route cannot be settled from the record, and what follows for her care (decision 4)

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择向家属坦诚说明并道歉（决策 5），并召开家属谈话、上报不良事件
text.en: Chose honest disclosure with an apology at the first attempt (decision 5), then held the family meeting and reported the incident

text.zh-CN: 向家属坦诚、通俗地说明发生了什么、正在做的治疗和不确定的预后，并确认他们听懂了
text.en: Told the family honestly and in plain words what happened, what is being done and how uncertain the outlook is, and checked they understood

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 按Calgary–Cambridge框架和职业坦诚义务评价与家属的谈话：开始——介绍自己和在场的上级医生、护士，确认对方是她的家属，安排安静的地方；了解——先问家属已经知道什么、最担心什么（“还能醒过来吗？是不是拔管出的事？”）；说明——用通俗的话讲：拔管时空气很可能经颈部针眼进入血管、到了脑部，这是一种拔管并发症；明确表示歉意，不推卸、不责怪她坐起；讲清正在做的治疗——纯氧和高压氧——为什么要做、怎么做、有哪些风险（耳部和鼻窦气压伤、氧中毒抽搐、加压前要排除气胸），并征求家属同意；如实说明预后不确定，不作虚假保证，也不说“没希望”；回应情绪，留出提问的时间；请家属复述关键内容以确认理解；告知已上报不良事件、医院会调查并改进，约定下次沟通的时间和联系人。本病例没有记录医生与家属谈了什么。
judgeGuidance.en: Judge the conversation with the family against the Calgary–Cambridge guide and the duty of candour. Initiating: introduce yourself and the senior doctor and nurse present, confirm who the relative is, find a quiet place. Gathering: ask first what they already know and what they fear ('Will she wake up? Did taking the line out cause this?'). Explaining: in plain words — air most likely got into the vein through the neck puncture when the line came out and travelled to the brain, a complication of the removal; apologise clearly, with no excuses and no blaming her for sitting up; explain the treatment — oxygen and hyperbaric oxygen — why, what it involves and its risks (ear and sinus barotrauma, oxygen-toxicity seizures, the pneumothorax check before compression), and seek the family's agreement; say honestly that the outlook is uncertain, with no false reassurance and no 'there is no hope'. Respond to emotion and leave time for questions; check understanding by teach-back; say the incident has been reported and will be reviewed, and agree when and with whom they will next talk. This case does not record what the family was told.

name.zh-CN: 孟医生（重症医学科主治医师，化名）

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教，只围绕学员已经拿到的资料提问，例如：“拔颈部导管时，穿刺点和心脏的高低有什么意义？为什么要在呼气后屏气时拔？”“她有房间隔缺损和肺动脉高压，拔管时你会多想到什么？”“她坐起来的那一刻改变了什么？”“这个时间点突然呼之不应、抽搐，你首先想到什么，还要排除什么？为什么不先送CT？”“为什么要纯氧？为什么现在不推荐头低位？”“加压前必须排除什么？她5天前做的是什么手术？”“右侧瞳孔反射迟钝能不能证明空气走的是哪条路？”“家属问‘是不是拔管出的事’，你怎么回答？”。可以讲INS 2024、WS/T 433—2023、Moon（UHMS 2019）、UHMS适应证手册（2023）、ECHM 2016、AES 2016和职业坦诚义务的相关原则。她双手遇冷发白疼痛，又有肺动脉高压：可以提出肺动脉高压的原因（与分流有关，还是结缔组织病等其他原因）需要专科评估，但本病例没有记录相关检查，不能断定。原报告的处理是历史记录，病例结束时才展示，届时再与现行指南对照。不提前说出诊断、任何决策的正确选项或结局；生命体征、血糖、CT细节、超声心动图数值和高压氧方案都没有记录，不要替它补上。
knowledge.en: A Socratic teacher who asks only about information the learner already has, for example: 'When a neck line comes out, why does it matter where the puncture is relative to the heart? Why pull it during a breath-hold after breathing out?', 'She has an atrial septal defect and pulmonary hypertension — what extra worry does that add to the removal?', 'What changed at the moment she sat up?', 'Unresponsive and convulsing at this moment — what comes first to mind, what else must be excluded, and why not go to CT first?', 'Why 100 % oxygen, and why is head-down no longer advised?', 'What must be excluded before compression, and what operation did she have 5 days ago?', 'Can a sluggish right pupil prove which route the air took?', 'Her relative asks whether taking the line out caused this — what do you say?'. May explain the relevant principles of INS 2024, WS/T 433—2023, Moon (UHMS 2019), the UHMS Indications Manual (2023), ECHM 2016, AES 2016 and the duty of candour. Her cold, white, painful hands with pulmonary hypertension: may point out that the cause of the pulmonary hypertension (shunt-related, or another cause such as a connective-tissue disease) needs specialist assessment, but the case records no such work-up, so nothing may be asserted. The report's management is a historical record shown at the end of the case and compared with current guidance only then. Never states the diagnosis, any decision's correct option or the outcome early; vital signs, glucose, CT details, echo measurements and the hyperbaric regimen are not recorded — do not supply them.

knowledge.zh-CN: 病房护士。交班（ISBAR）：51岁女性，胸交感神经链切断术后第5天；右颈内静脉中心静脉导管今天拔除；她最初因双手遇冷发白、疼痛来看病，检查中发现过心脏问题，此前的超声心动图报告在病历里。病房设备：床旁有氧气接口和监护仪，抢救车里有气道用物、吸引和静脉穿刺用物，快速血糖仪和心电图机在病房，输液泵在床旁；ICU有高压氧舱。可以按医嘱压住并封闭穿刺点、给氧、连接监护、测指尖血糖、建立静脉通路、呼叫急救团队、协助转运。复述医嘱，只报告已经发生的情况和已经出来的结果，不解读、不诊断；问到没有记录的内容（生命体征、血糖、由谁拔的管）就如实说没有记录。
knowledge.en: Ward nurse. Handover (ISBAR): a 51-year-old woman on post-operative day 5 after a thoracic sympathectomy; her right internal jugular central line is due out today; she first came with hands that turn white and painful in the cold, a heart problem was found during that work-up, and the earlier echocardiogram report is in the notes. Kit: the oxygen outlet and the monitor are at her bed, the crash cart holds airway, suction and cannulation kit, the glucometer and the ECG machine are on the ward, the infusion pump is at the bed; intensive care has a hyperbaric chamber. Can, on instruction, press and seal the puncture, give oxygen, attach the monitor, check a capillary glucose, place a cannula, call the emergency team and help with the transfer. Reads back orders and reports only what has happened and results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses, and says plainly when something is not recorded (vital signs, glucose, who removed the line).

name.zh-CN: 甘医生（高压氧医学科，化名）

knowledge.zh-CN: 高压氧科医生，只解读学员已经看过的资料。可以讲：高压氧的适应证（UHMS适应证手册第15版，2023，列有空气或气体栓塞；ECHM 2016共识列为1类推荐）；为什么越早加压越好、影像阴性也不取消治疗；常用的治疗方案（如美国海军6号治疗表）；加压前清单——排除气胸（胸部手术后尤其要查，有则先放引流）、气管导管套囊改注生理盐水、舱内可用的呼吸机和输液泵、镇静和抽搐的处理、观察中耳气压伤和氧中毒惊厥；插管、机械通气的患者也可以进舱。不说出诊断结论，不透露结局；本病例没有记录高压氧开始的时间、压力和次数，不要替它补上。
knowledge.en: Hyperbaric physician who interprets only what the learner has already read. Can explain: the indications (the UHMS Indications Manual, 15th ed., 2023, lists air or gas embolism; the ECHM 2016 consensus gives it a Type 1 recommendation); why earlier compression is better and why a clear scan does not cancel treatment; the usual treatment tables (such as US Navy Treatment Table 6); the pre-compression checklist — exclude a pneumothorax (above all after chest surgery; drain one first), saline in the tube cuff, a chamber-compatible ventilator and pumps, sedation and seizure management, and watching for middle-ear barotrauma and oxygen-toxicity seizures; intubated, ventilated patients can be treated in the chamber. Does not state the diagnosis or reveal the outcome; the case does not record when hyperbaric oxygen began, the pressure or the number of sessions — do not supply them.

knowledge.zh-CN: 放射科医生，只解读学员已经看过的影像。可以说明：急诊头颅CT报告为颅内空气栓塞；血管内气体可以很快吸收，CT阴性不能排除气体栓塞；血管内气栓与血管外积气（气颅）的区别；把插管患者送去做MRI会推迟高压氧。本病例没有记录CT的时间、气体的部位、分布和多少，也没有胸片或MRI结果，不要补充。
knowledge.en: Radiologist who interprets only images the learner has already read. Can explain: the emergency head CT was reported as intracranial air embolism; intravascular gas can resorb quickly, so a clear CT does not exclude gas embolism; intravascular gas versus extravascular air (pneumocephalus); taking a ventilated patient to MRI delays hyperbaric oxygen. The case records neither the timing of the CT nor where the gas was, its distribution or amount, and has no chest film or MRI result — add nothing.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：中心静脉导管拔除后的脑空气栓塞
title.en: Debrief: cerebral air embolism after central-line removal

conclusion.zh-CN: 51岁女性，双手遇冷发白疼痛，检查中发现房间隔缺损和肺动脉高压；胸交感神经链切断术后第5天拔除右颈内静脉导管：平卧拔管，按压约1分钟，普通胶布覆盖。约3分钟后她坐起时突然呼之不应、呼吸短促并抽搐；大动脉搏动可触及，双侧瞳孔等大，右侧对光反射迟钝。给氧后气管插管，急诊头颅CT示颅内空气栓塞——中心静脉导管拔除后的脑空气栓塞。原报告记录呼吸支持、高压氧和康复治疗；次日神志转清但左侧重度偏瘫，约第35天能独立行走。现行做法：拔颈部导管时穿刺点低于心脏、屏气拔出、封闭敷料并平卧一段时间；出现这样的情况按气体栓塞处理，不等CT——封闭穿刺点、水平位、纯氧、保护气道——排除气胸后尽快高压氧。
conclusion.en: A 51-year-old woman with cold-induced white, painful hands, an atrial septal defect and pulmonary hypertension had her right internal jugular line removed on day 5 after a thoracic sympathectomy: lying flat, about a minute of pressure, ordinary tape. About 3 minutes later, sitting up, she became unresponsive with short, rapid breaths and convulsions; a central pulse was palpable, her pupils equal with a sluggish right light reflex. After oxygen she was intubated; the emergency head CT showed intracranial air embolism. The report records respiratory support, hyperbaric oxygen and rehabilitation; alert next day with severe left hemiplegia, she walked independently by about day 35. Today: remove neck lines with the site below the heart, a breath-hold, an air-occlusive seal and time lying flat; treat such a collapse as cerebral gas embolism without waiting for a scan — seal, horizontal, 100 % oxygen, airway — and recompress early once a pneumothorax is excluded.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 时间和体位是关键线索：拔除右颈内静脉导管约3分钟后，就在她坐起的那一刻发病——穿刺点高过了心脏，而针眼上只贴着普通胶布。
keyReasoning.en: Timing and posture are the clues: she collapsed about 3 minutes after the right internal jugular line came out, at the very moment she sat up — the puncture now above her heart and covered only by ordinary tape.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 床旁表现是循环尚存的神经系统急症：呼之不应、呼吸短促、抽搐，大动脉搏动可及，右侧瞳孔对光反射迟钝——指向脑部受累，而不是心跳骤停或单纯晕厥。
keyReasoning.en: The bedside picture is a neurological emergency with the circulation preserved: unresponsive, short rapid breaths, convulsions, a palpable central pulse and a sluggish right pupil — pointing to the brain, not to cardiac arrest or a simple faint.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 背景让风险更高：房间隔缺损伴肺动脉高压，为静脉里的气体进入动脉提供了一条可能的通道。
keyReasoning.en: The background raises the stakes: an atrial septal defect with pulmonary hypertension offers venous air a possible path into the arteries.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 先治疗、后确认：纯氧和尽早加压都有时间依赖性；本例的CT证实了颅内空气栓塞，但即使CT阴性，处理也不应改变。
keyReasoning.en: Treat first, confirm later: oxygen and early recompression are time-dependent; her CT confirmed intracranial air embolism, but a clear scan should not have changed the plan.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 看结局要谨慎：她次日清醒但左侧重度偏瘫，约第35天能独立行走——说明恢复是可能的，但单个病例说明不了高压氧起了多大作用。
keyReasoning.en: Read the outcome with care: alert the next day with severe left hemiplegia and walking independently by about day 35, she shows that recovery is possible, but one case cannot show how much hyperbaric oxygen contributed.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单个病例报告，而且本版本的患者事实只来自1.0.0版的提取，尚未对照原文全文核对：它不能说明高压氧的作用有多大，也不能确定气体进入脑部的途径。原报告的处理作为历史事实保留；决策、干预和评分依据现行指南设计，属于教学设计。拔管地点（本病例放在病房）、转入ICU的时间、ICU里的家属及其对话都是教学安排；生命体征、血糖、影像细节和高压氧方案没有记录，本病例不作补充。
boundaries.en: This is a single case report, and in this version its patient facts come only from the version 1.0.0 extraction, not yet checked against the full article: it cannot show how much hyperbaric oxygen helped or establish the route the air took to the brain. The report's management is kept as historical fact; the decisions, interventions and scoring follow current guidance and are teaching design. Where the line came out (placed on the ward here), when she reached intensive care and the relative there with the dialogue are teaching arrangements; vital signs, glucose, imaging details and the hyperbaric regimen are not recorded, and the case adds none.

unknowns.zh-CN: 任何阶段的生命体征（心率、血压、血氧饱和度、呼吸频率、体温）以及出事时的格拉斯哥评分和血糖。
unknowns.en: Vital signs at any stage (heart rate, blood pressure, oxygen saturation, respiratory rate, temperature), and the Glasgow score and glucose at the collapse.

unknowns.zh-CN: 超声心动图的细节：缺损的类型和大小、分流方向、肺动脉压力、检查日期，以及是否做过发泡试验或其他动态分流检查。
unknowns.en: The echocardiogram details: the type and size of the defect, the shunt direction, the pulmonary pressures, the date, and any bubble study or other dynamic shunt evidence.

unknowns.zh-CN: 手术的细节：入路、侧别和节段、麻醉方式、胸腔引流、术后是否有气胸或拍过胸片；中心静脉导管何时、为什么放置。
unknowns.en: The operation: approach, side and levels, the anaesthetic, chest drains, any post-operative pneumothorax or chest film; when and why the central line was inserted.

unknowns.zh-CN: 拔管的细节：在病房还是ICU、由谁拔管、是否屏气或放低床头，她是自己坐起还是被扶起；进入的空气量。
unknowns.en: The removal: ward or intensive care, who removed the line, any breath-hold or head-down tilt, whether she sat up by herself or was helped; the volume of air.

unknowns.zh-CN: 头颅CT：发病后多久做的，气体的部位、分布和多少；是否复查过CT或MRI。
unknowns.en: The head CT: how long after the event, where the gas was, its distribution and amount; any repeat CT or MRI.

unknowns.zh-CN: 高压氧治疗：距发病多久开始、舱型、压力、每次时长和次数，是否带机进舱；用过的其他药物（镇静、抗惊厥等）、机械通气时间和拔管时间。
unknowns.en: Hyperbaric oxygen: the delay from the event, the chamber type, pressure, session length and number of sessions, whether she was ventilated in the chamber; other drugs (sedation, anticonvulsants), how long she was ventilated and when she was extubated.

unknowns.zh-CN: 远期结局：遗留的神经功能缺损、认知功能、出院情况、房间隔缺损和肺动脉高压的后续处理，以及“约第35天”是从哪一天算起。
unknowns.en: The longer-term outcome: residual deficits, cognition, discharge, what was done about the septal defect and the pulmonary hypertension, and the day from which 'about day 35' is counted.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 拔除颈部中心静脉导管：穿刺点低于心脏（平卧或头低位），呼气后屏气（或Valsalva动作）时拔出，按压至止血，用不透气的封闭敷料覆盖，并保持平卧一段时间（INS 2024输液治疗实践标准；国内导管拔除按国家卫生健康委WS/T 433—2023执行）。宾夕法尼亚患者安全管理局2012年的分析中，拔管时患者处于直立位是最常报告的相关因素。原报告中她平卧拔管、按压约1分钟、用普通胶布覆盖，约3分钟后坐起时发病。
teachingPoints.en: Removing a neck line: the site below the heart (flat or head-down), the catheter out during a breath-hold after breathing out (or a Valsalva manoeuvre), pressure to haemostasis, an air-occlusive dressing and a period lying flat (INS Infusion Therapy Standards of Practice 2024; in China removal follows the National Health Commission's WS/T 433—2023). In the Pennsylvania Patient Safety Authority's 2012 analysis, an upright position at removal was the most often reported contributing factor. In the report she lay flat for the removal, had about a minute of pressure and ordinary tape, and collapsed on sitting up about 3 minutes later.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 识别：拔管后数分钟内——尤其是坐起时——出现意识障碍、抽搐或局灶体征，应按气体栓塞处理，直到排除；诊断靠临床，血管内气体在影像上常常看不到，不能用影像来排除（Moon，UHMS 2019；另见Mitchell、Bennett与Moon，NEJM 2022）。本例急诊头颅CT显示颅内空气栓塞：阳性结果支持诊断，但阴性结果也不该改变处理。
teachingPoints.en: Recognition: impaired consciousness, seizures or focal signs within minutes of line removal — above all on sitting up — are gas embolism until proven otherwise; the diagnosis is clinical, and intravascular gas is often invisible on imaging, which cannot exclude it (Moon, UHMS 2019; see also Mitchell, Bennett and Moon, NEJM 2022). Her emergency head CT showed intracranial air embolism: a positive scan supports the diagnosis, but a clear one should not change the plan.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 最初几分钟：按压并封闭穿刺点，呼救；保持水平位（气道未保护时侧卧，插管后仰卧）——头低位已不再推荐，可能加重脑水肿（Moon 2019）；高流量纯氧；保护气道（原报告记录给氧后气管插管）；抽搐不停时用苯二氮䓬类：劳拉西泮0.1 mg/kg静脉注射（最大4 mg）、地西泮0.15–0.2 mg/kg静脉注射（最大10 mg），没有静脉通路时咪达唑仑10 mg肌内注射（体重>40 kg）（AES 2016）；查血糖，维持正常血压。
teachingPoints.en: The first minutes: press on and seal the site and call for help; keep her horizontal (on her side while the airway is unprotected, on her back once it is secured) — head-down is no longer recommended and can worsen cerebral oedema (Moon 2019); high-flow 100 % oxygen; secure the airway (the report records oxygen, then intubation); for a seizure that does not stop, a benzodiazepine — lorazepam 0.1 mg/kg IV (max 4 mg), diazepam 0.15–0.2 mg/kg IV (max 10 mg), or midazolam 10 mg IM without IV access (> 40 kg; AES 2016); check glucose and keep the blood pressure normal.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 高压氧是动脉气体栓塞的根本治疗，经血管通路进入的气体也包括在内：UHMS适应证手册（第15版，2023）列为适应证，ECHM 2016共识列为1类推荐；距发病越早加压，预后越好（Moon 2019），不要等影像。加压前排除气胸——她5天前做过胸部手术，有气胸先引流——气管导管套囊改注生理盐水，准备舱内可用的呼吸机。原报告记录了高压氧治疗，本病例没有记录其开始时间、压力和次数。
teachingPoints.en: Hyperbaric oxygen is the definitive treatment of arterial gas embolism, including gas that enters through a vascular line: an indication in the UHMS Indications Manual (15th ed., 2023) and a Type 1 recommendation of the ECHM 2016 consensus; a shorter delay to recompression goes with better outcomes (Moon 2019), so imaging must not hold it up. Before compression exclude a pneumothorax — she had chest surgery 5 days ago; drain one first — fill the tube cuff with saline and use a chamber-compatible ventilator. The report records hyperbaric oxygen; this case does not record when it began, the pressure or the number of sessions.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 途径与今后：静脉内的空气可以经心内分流进入动脉（肺动脉高压时房间隔缺损可出现右向左分流），也可以在直立时沿颈内静脉逆行进入脑静脉（Bothma与Schlimp，2014），现有记录不能区分是哪一条，处理相同。今后所有输液管路都要排净空气、能用时加空气滤器；房间隔缺损和肺动脉高压需要专科评估——能否封堵取决于右心导管测得的分流和肺血管阻力（ESC 2020成人先心病指南；ESC/ERS 2022肺动脉高压指南）。
teachingPoints.en: The route and what follows: venous air can reach the arteries across an intracardiac shunt (right-to-left through an ASD in pulmonary hypertension) or rise up the jugular vein into the cerebral veins when the patient is upright (Bothma and Schlimp, 2014); nothing recorded separates them, and the treatment is the same. From now on every line is de-aired, with air filters where available, and the ASD and pulmonary hypertension need specialist assessment — closure depends on the shunt and the pulmonary vascular resistance measured at right-heart catheterisation (ESC 2020 adult congenital heart disease; ESC/ERS 2022 pulmonary hypertension).

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 坦诚告知：出了问题，应当告诉患者或家属并道歉（GMC与NMC职业坦诚义务，2015年发布、2022年更新）；《医疗纠纷预防和处理条例》（国务院令第701号，2018）要求向患者说明病情和医疗措施，对特殊治疗说明风险和替代方案，并通过医患沟通机制回应疑问。本病例没有记录与家属的沟通，这里的家属是教学角色。
teachingPoints.en: Candour: when something has gone wrong, tell the patient or family and apologise (GMC and NMC professional duty of candour, 2015, updated 2022); China's Regulations on the Prevention and Handling of Medical Disputes (State Council Decree No. 701, 2018) require clinicians to explain the condition and the measures taken, explain the risks and alternatives of special treatments, and answer questions through a communication mechanism. This case records no conversation with the family; the relative here is a teaching role.
